parameters.query:
-- Orders pushed 3-25 min ago at active stores that have not been settled by the watchdog yet.
-- Lightspeed decides DONE vs NEW the instant a receipt is created, so one look at 3 min is enough.
SELECT co.id::text AS canonical_id, co.ls_order_id, co.external_ref, co.source::text AS source, co.location_key,
       to_char(co.ls_pushed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD') AS d0,
       to_char((co.ls_pushed_at - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD') AS d1,
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - co.ls_pushed_at))/60)::int AS age_min,
       t.access_token
FROM public.canonical_orders co
JOIN public.dim_location dl ON dl.location_key = co.location_key AND COALESCE(dl.is_active, true)
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT access_token FROM public.ls_tokens x WHERE x.location_key = co.location_key ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true
LEFT JOIN public.ls_receipt_watch w ON w.canonical_id = co.id
WHERE co.ls_order_id IS NOT NULL
  AND co.status IN ('ls_accepted','shipday_sent','complete')
  AND co.ls_pushed_at BETWEEN now() - interval '25 minutes' AND now() - interval '3 minutes'
  AND (w.canonical_id IS NULL OR (w.status NOT IN ('DONE','PAID') AND NOT w.alerted AND w.checks < 5))
ORDER BY co.ls_pushed_at
LIMIT 20;
